NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ghar uses the microphone for voice search and for recording a spoken property description.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Ghar uses your location to show properties near you.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Ghar needs your photos so you can add pictures to a listing.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Ghar uses the camera so you can photograph a property for a listing.
